axes.xDefinition: log10 rotation velocity, maximum circular velocity V_max of the halo (the green curve in the paper's Fig. 6)
axes.yDefinition: log10 baryonic mass M_bar (stars plus 1.4 M_HI within r_gal)

representation.equation: M_bar/Msun = m0 nu^alpha exp(-nu^gamma), nu = V / (50 km/s)

selection.population: simulated galaxies of the EAGLE Ref-L100N1504 volume and the APOSTLE zoom volumes (Local Group analogues) at z=0, all morphologies
selection.warning: Fit of Sales et al. 2017 with a slope that steepens towards low velocity (V_max). The domain is the extent of the drawn curve in the paper's figure; the formula reproduces that curve to 0.008 dex at every vertex (checked in the script). M_bar uses gas = 1.4 M_HI (HI from the Rahmati+13 prescription). APOSTLE is a zoom sample, not volume complete.
